cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put her on speaker. You'll be there for the whole thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's fine. Introduce the idea, and when she says my full name, I'll answer.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You called my audition interesting. What came after that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to be encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then give me the encouraging half and the half you swallowed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better by how much? Are we buying dance lessons or shoes that don't move?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before we open the landlord's letter, tell me the worst thing it could mean for our shop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've only missed one payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know the number. I need you to say the thing I'm counting towards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could lose the shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after Dad trusted me with it? Say that bit first too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we open the landlord's letter, tell me the worst thing it could mean for our shop.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know the number. I need you to say the thing I'm counting towards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could lose the shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after Dad trusted me with it? Say that bit first too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Compare the angry letter with the one I sent. Notice the crossing-out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciate the apology you sent. Why show me the angry version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Because 'sorry' took ten minutes. Not sending the rest took all night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I'm tempted to read what you spared me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please admire the thickness with it shut. I'd like one night's restraint to survive breakfast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told the committee I couldn't chair another year. Please appreciate what those two sentences took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. Could you stay on until we find someone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rehearsed in your car until I stopped apologising. That wasn't me advertising a temporary vacancy.

beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't supply the excuse I spent an hour removing. Could you recognise a refusal I finally managed without one?

beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't supply the excuse I spent an hour removing. Could you recognise a refusal I finally managed without one?
